en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Sunnah regarding the Ihraam is the clipping of the nails, and taking off the moustache, and shaving the pubic area’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Of the Sunnah in Ihram is to trim finger nails, mustache and pubic hairs.’”
